title: a16z Podcast: Mapping the Future of Virtual Reality

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Virtual reality is coming fast.
reader_summary.overview: Virtual reality is coming fast, and everyone seems to assume that it will be gamers who get to have all the fun first. But there are other applications for VR that could also bring it into the mainstream. “It could very well be business users,” says 16z’s Chris Dixon.

key_points.text: “It’s anything where you would want time travel or teleportation.” Dixon is joined on this segment of the podcast by Saku Panditharatne and Kyle Russell.
This year promises to be the moment when more than a very small number of people will get their first taste of VR.
What that looks and feels like, and what that shared experience sets in motion on this segment of the a16z podcast.
